name: ai-software-delivery-room
description: Multi-agent software delivery for Claude: discovery (brief, roadmap, business case, use cases), architecture and design-system stages, per-agent runtime tiers (T1/T2/T3, Task/Workspace/Gateway/Model), sprint execution with a plan→build→independent-QA triad, traceability with drift detection, Cypress E2E, context discipline (measured facts, contract pre-flight, budgeted packs), companion detection and in-run update checks. The state machine lives in scripts, not the model's memory.
